library(biomaRt)

```{r functions}
# Seconds to wait between Ensembl requests. Archive hosts are smaller than the
# main site and degrade under back-to-back queries.
ENSEMBL_DELAY <- 3

# biomaRt passes getOption("timeout") to req_timeout(), and R's default is 60s.
# A cold archive host can take ~50s just to return the registry, so the default
# leaves almost no headroom and a slow response aborts as a gateway timeout.
options(timeout = 600)

# Retry a request on transient server-side failures. A 504 from the archive is
# usually momentary, and without a retry one slow response kills a run that has
# already spent many minutes downloading.
#
# The non-HTTP patterns are included deliberately. When the archive is briefly
# overloaded it serves an HTML "Service unavailable" page with HTTP 200, and
# biomaRt parses that page as if it were data. Depending on which request hit
# the bad response, that surfaces as
#   The given dataset: <name>, is not valid.          (dataset list)
#   biomaRt error: looks like we're connecting to
#     incompatible version of BioMart.                (attributes/filters)
# Both look like configuration errors but are really outages: the same request
# a few seconds later succeeds.
with_retry <- function(expr, what, tries = 6) {
    expr <- enquo(expr)
    for (i in seq_len(tries)) {
        result <- try(eval_tidy(expr), silent = TRUE)
        if (!inherits(result, "try-error")) return(result)

        msg <- conditionMessage(attr(result, "condition"))
        transient <- grepl(paste("50[234]", "429", "timed? ?out", "Timeout",
                                 "is not valid", "unavailable",
                                 "incompatible version",
                                 sep = "|"),
                           msg, ignore.case = TRUE)
        if (!transient || i == tries) stop(msg, call. = FALSE)

        # Cap the backoff so a long run does not stall for many minutes on one
        # dataset, but give the host well over a minute to recover.
        wait <- min(ENSEMBL_DELAY * 2^i, 120)
        message(sprintf("  %s failed (%s); retry %d/%d in %ds",
                        what, trimws(msg), i, tries - 1, wait))
        Sys.sleep(wait)
    }
}

# The BioMart registry served by the archive advertises host="www.ensembl.org"
# for every mart. useMart() follows that for its dataset-list request, and
# www.ensembl.org 308-redirects BioMart to a GET-only endpoint: the redirect
# returns an empty body, which biomaRt reports as
#   "looks like we're connecting to incompatible version of BioMart"
# and a POSTed query there returns 405. Patching mart@host after useMart()
# returns is too late, because the bad request already happened inside it.
#
# Build the Mart object directly instead, so every request stays on the recipe's
# host. Also caches one mart per host+dataset: useMart() would otherwise refetch
# the same registry for all 11 recipes, twice over (genes and tx2gene).
mart_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

get_mart <- function(recipe) {
    key <- paste(recipe$host, recipe$biomart, recipe$dataset)
    if (!is.null(mart_cache[[key]])) return(mart_cache[[key]])

    host <- paste0(sub("/$", "", recipe$host), ":443/biomart/martservice")

    mart <- new("Mart",
                biomart     = recipe$biomart,
                host        = host,
                vschema     = "default",
                http_config = list())

    # useDataset() fills in the attribute and filter metadata that getBM()
    # needs, and because the host is already pinned every request it makes
    # stays on the archive.
    mart <- with_retry(useDataset(mart = mart, dataset = recipe$dataset),
                       what = paste("useDataset", recipe$dataset))

    mart_cache[[key]] <- mart
    mart
}

get_data <- function(recipe) {
    message(recipe$dataset)
    mart <- get_mart(recipe)
    attr <- unlist(recipe$attributes, use.names = FALSE)
    on.exit(Sys.sleep(ENSEMBL_DELAY), add = TRUE)
    with_retry(getBM(attr, mart = mart), what = paste("getBM", recipe$dataset))
}

tidy_data <- function(df, recipe, tx = FALSE) {
    df <- df %>%
        as_tibble %>%
        distinct %>%
        rename(!!!syms(recipe$attributes)) %>%
        arrange(!!sym("ensgene"))
    if (!tx) {
        df <- df %>% mutate(description = sub("\ \\[.+\\]", "", description, perl = TRUE))
    }
    return(df)
}

save_data <- function(..., name) {
    path <- file.path("data", paste0(name, ".rda"))
    objs <- setNames(list(...), name)
    save(list = name, file = path, envir = list2env(objs), compress = "xz")
}

# Progress log. The Ensembl archive is unreliable enough that a full build often
# dies partway through, and without this every completed download is thrown away
# on the next attempt. Each table is recorded here as soon as it is written to
# data/, so a rerun skips it. The log is deleted once every table is present,
# leaving no state behind after a clean build.
PROGRESS_LOG <- file.path("data-raw", "build_progress.log")

completed <- function() {
    if (!file.exists(PROGRESS_LOG)) return(character(0))
    unique(readLines(PROGRESS_LOG, warn = FALSE))
}

mark_complete <- function(name) {
    cat(name, "\n", sep = "", file = PROGRESS_LOG, append = TRUE)
}

# Download, tidy, save and document one table, unless it is already done.
build_table <- function(recipe, name, tx = FALSE) {
    if (name %in% completed()) {
        message("skipping ", name, " (already built)")
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    df <- get_data(recipe) %>% tidy_data(recipe, tx = tx)
    save_data(df, name = name)
    document_annotable(recipe, name, type = if (tx) "tx2gene" else "gene")

    mark_complete(name)
    invisible(NULL)
}

# Drop the log only when nothing is left to do.
clear_progress_if_done <- function(expected) {
    if (all(expected %in% completed())) {
        unlink(PROGRESS_LOG)
        message("all tables built; removed ", PROGRESS_LOG)
    } else {
        missing <- setdiff(expected, completed())
        message(length(missing), " table(s) still missing: ",
                paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    }
}
```

```{r load_recipes}
recipe.files <- file.path("data-raw", "recipes") %>%
    dir(pattern = "\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
names(recipe.files) <- sub(".yml", "", basename(recipe.files))
recipes <- lapply(recipe.files, yaml.load_file)
```

```{r gene_annotation_tables, cache=FALSE}
# Each table is downloaded, saved and logged one at a time, so a failure part
# way through keeps everything already finished.
Map(build_table, recipes, names(recipes), tx = FALSE)
```

```{r tx2gene, cache=FALSE}
# Kept in a separate variable rather than overwriting `recipes`, so this chunk
# can be re-run on its own without leaving the gene recipes clobbered.
tx_recipes <- lapply(recipes, function(x) {
    x$attributes <- c(
        enstxp = "ensembl_transcript_id",
        ensgene = "ensembl_gene_id")
    x
})
names(tx_recipes) <- paste(names(recipes), "tx2gene", sep = "_")

Map(build_table, tx_recipes, names(tx_recipes), tx = TRUE)

# Every gene and tx2gene table is now accounted for, so the progress log can go.
clear_progress_if_done(c(names(recipes), names(tx_recipes)))
```

```{r ensembl_version}
ensembl_version <- listMarts() %>%
    filter(biomart == "ENSEMBL_MART_ENSEMBL") %>%
    pull(version)
save_data(ensembl_version, name = "ensembl_version")
```
